## What

Describe the focused change and its public contract.

## Why

Explain the problem, alternatives considered, and any linked ADR or issue.

## How tested

List the exact commands run and any manual review performed.

## Rollback

Describe how to reverse the change and any state or contract migration involved.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] `make ci` and `make package-check` pass.
- [ ] No credentials, citizen data, private flows, or generated evidence are included.
- [ ] Public contract and changelog changes are explicit.
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed.
